name: Rules that act on the computer
what: A rule can also act on the computer itself and alert you. For example, if a fake secret that no honest task uses ever leaves, the rule denies it, stops the computer and alerts you. An alert alone decides nothing at the boundary: the other rules still allow, hold or deny the request.

suggest.why: A fact that should never happen, such as a fake secret leaving, deserves more than one denied request, and it may happen while you are away.
